# Data and code availability

Atrophy maps: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7392621 and 10.5281/zenodo.10383493 (CC-BY-4.0).
Connectomes: ENIGMA toolbox (commit b08974b). Atlases: Schaefer 2018 (CBIG, commit 634f676)
and Tian S1 (commit dcad934). Code, parcellated data, validation reports and the network
package (`netcomm`, `R CMD check` passing) are in the project repository; every number in this
manuscript is computed from cached results by `scripts/15_manuscript_results.R`.
